ideas.pitch: A BPMN-orchestrated multi-agent compliance pipeline that performs pre-deployment risk assessments for automated workflows.
ideas.title: AgenticBPMN: Autonomous Multi-Agent Risk and Compliance Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Agentic AI track by moving beyond basic chatbots into structured agent workflows with human-in-the-loop governance, mirroring a proven winning pattern.

ideas.pitch: A training-free, self-improving semantic router utilizing kNN exemplar indexing and automated LLM-judge writebacks to optimize routing accuracy and lower inference costs.
ideas.title: SemanticRoute-Q: Self-Improving Dynamic LLM Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high technical difficulty with an immediately quantifiable metric (routing cost reduction and accuracy boost), appealing strongly to technical judges.

ideas.pitch: An automated RAG toolkit that integrates native auto-embedding indexing directly within MariaDB to streamline document retrieval for enterprise databases.
ideas.title: MariaDB-TOON: Native Auto-Embedding & RAG Toolkit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers practical data engineering value with a clear database integration angle, echoing successful data infrastructure hacks.

ideas.pitch: A federated Model Context Protocol (MCP) server mesh on Kubernetes designed for secure, distributed medical and clinical data AI agent workflows.
ideas.title: K-Federate: Federated MCP Server Registry on Kubernetes
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases complex distributed systems and DevOps engineering (K8s and service mesh) which stands out drastically in a field of basic wrapper applications.

ideas.pitch: An interactive data profiling engine that runs automated exploratory data analysis, checks cardinality and schema consistency, and generates instant integrity ratings.
ideas.title: DataVeritas-EDA: Automated Data Integrity & Profiling Suite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an everyday developer and data scientist pain point with a polished full-stack interface and instant, actionable utility.
